# ServiceNow Release Notes — captured 2026-05-20

## Australia release family (released May 5, 2026; patches through May 2026)
Built on the ServiceNow AI Platform.

### Agentic AI features in Australia release:
- AI Desktop Actions ("Agentic Desktop") — agent workflows performing actions on the user's desktop
- AI Control Tower — system for managing/overseeing AI operations across the platform
- Now Assist AI Agents — dedicated AI agent implementation (multiple per product: ITSM, FSM, CSM, etc.)
- Agentic Contact Center for Banking — industry-specific agent solution
- AI Agent Advisor — guidance system for agent optimization

Patches: Australia Patch 1, Patch 2, EA Hotfix 1.
